description: We're a full team of friends who work well together. Between us we cover machine learning, computer vision, full-stack development, design, research, science, and data analysis. We like learning by solving real problems, an idea Elon Musk has talked about, and we figure things out as we go. For Dancing with the SARs, we want to use data analysis, ML, and computer vision to make SAR data easier to work with in a simple interface.
